These are unmodified upstream archives fetched on 2026-09-27 from the exact URLs
in ../sources.json. All checksums are mandatory in the Linux build. They were
downloaded for static inspection only; no Windows compilation or execution.

The first Linux download of the pinned kernel.googlesource archive returned HTTP
503 on every retry. Keeping the checked original bytes here makes the source
input independent of that mirror outage. No TLS or checksum check was disabled.
The public source tarballs accompany binary delivery to preserve source access.
MLC 3.13 is the original pinned Intel archive, added for this private deployment
distribution on 2026-09-28. Its binary, license, redist.txt and documentation are
packaged without modification. Intel's own terms continue to apply; this is not
an assertion of unrestricted redistribution rights. SPEC/0730 is not committed.

For the public snapshot, the publisher explicitly confirmed additional MLC 3.13
redistribution authorization on 2026-09-30. See docs/releases/PUBLICATION.md for
the official license link and the mislabelled vendor license member. Neither
that confirmation nor this repository relicenses Intel materials as GPL.
